# US evidence rules — authentication of electronic evidence (FRE 901, 902, proposed 707; 28 U.S.C. § 1746): clause → mechanism → status

This table maps clauses to SecuraCV mechanisms. It is not a determination: the court decides whether a deployment's records and controls are acceptable. The receipt ledgers are the record; this table points at them. Status words: [STATUS.md](STATUS.md). The frame: [README.md](README.md).
